Marco (Helix): Hi team — we're about to kick off a 10-day POC next Monday. Need a billing project/org with $1,000 trial credits, a hard spend shield set at $1,000, and ephemeral API keys for 4 devs (prefer 48h TTL). Also want a small Dedicated node (1xA10G) in us-west-2 with VPC peering. Any blockers?

Dana S: Welcome Marco. We can provision those. Quick confirmations: 1) credits + hard spend shield, 2) project-scoped ephemeral keys (48h), 3) Dedicated 1xA10G us-west-2, 4) VPC peering details and log retention. Who will sign the spend-ack?

Marco (Helix): I'll sign. Email marco@helix.ai. For logs, compliance needs 90d retention and delivery to our S3. We also want to restrict models to quantized families for cost.

Ethan (SE): We can apply a model whitelist at the project level. Suggested policy: allowed_models:["quant-ggml-*","tiny-llama-*"], max_tokens_per_minute=12000, max_generation_tokens=512. For ephemeral keys, we can issue 172800s TTL (48h) and optional IP allowlist. Example request we use internally:

```
POST /v1/projects/{proj_id}/ephemeral-keys
Authorization: Bearer RESELLER_TOKEN
Body: {"ttl_seconds":172800, "notes":"helix dev key", "ip_allowlist":["52.12.0.0/16"]}
```

Leah B: Billing notes: We'll seed $1,000 in credits and create a hard spend shield that blocks calls when exhausted. Legal needs the spend ack signed; once returned credits and cap are applied. We also enable soft alerts at 75% by default and can send them to a Slack channel. Which channel?

Marco (Helix): Please route alerts to #helix-poc. Also: can we get per-route quotas so CI can only call embeddings? We don't want generation used by CI.

Ethan (SE): Yep — keys can be route-scoped. We'll create a project service key for CI restricted to embeddings.create and IP-restricted to your CI runners. Dev keys will be generation-enabled.

Anil I: Infra checklist: need VPC CIDR and AWS account id for peering. We'll enable flow logs to deliver to your S3 bucket with 90d retention. Peering typically completes in ~3-5 hours.

Marco (Helix): VPC CIDR 10.30.0.0/16, AWS acct 987654321000, logs bucket arn: arn:aws:s3:::helix-redwood-logs.

InfraBot: Created ticket INF-6123 for Dedicated + peering. Status: awaiting validation. ETA 4h after validation.

Dana S: Action items: Leah to provision billing project and apply credits + hard shield; Anil to file Dedicated provisioning + peering; Ethan to create 4 dev ephemeral keys (48h TTL) and 1 CI service key (embeddings-only); Marco to sign spend ack. I'll follow up with links.

Leah B: Sending spend ack to marco@helix.ai via DocuSign now. Once signed I'll apply credits and lock the spend shield.

Ethan (SE): Creating keys now. I'll DM the dev keys securely and attach the CI service key to the project. Note: dev keys will have a rate-limited default of 200 rpm; request increase if needed.

Marco (Helix): Signed the doc.

Leah B: Credits applied and hard spend shield enforced. Confirmation email sent. Soft alerts posted to #helix-poc.

InfraBot: INF-6123 updated: VPC CIDR and AWS account added; flow logs target=arn:aws:s3:::helix-redwood-logs; retention=90d. Provisioning in progress.

Anil I: Provisioning complete for Dedicated 1xA10G in us-west-2. Peering established. Please confirm you can reach the endpoint from your VPC.

Marco (Helix): Able to reach endpoint and running smoke tests. Dev keys received — thanks. CI key scoped to embeddings works. Quick question: can you shorten dev TTL to 24h for tighter security?

Ethan (SE): Yes; we rotated dev keys to 24h TTL per request and updated the repo with a rotation script. Pushed example to examples/helix/poc.

Marco (Helix): All green on our side. Thanks for fast turnaround! :rocket:

Dana S: Great — closing this loop. Reopen if anything else pops up.

Marco (Helix): Will do, appreciate the help.
